description:
Issue summary:
Request procurement of AuthLatch enterprise SSO + SCIM subscription to replace ad-hoc Okta app used by platform team and to offload contractor lifecycle.

Impact:
- Platform and Research teams need automated provisioning for 35 permanent seats and a guaranteed pool of 15 contractor seats that expire automatically. Manual onboarding is causing delays and missed offboarding events.
- We require VPC-integrated audit log export (weekly/monthly) to our central log bucket for compliance audits.

Background:
- AuthLatch was selected after a short vendor evaluation for lower latency SSO flows in our multi-region setup and a cleaner SCIM API. Security completed an initial questionnaire and requested details on BYOK and audit export retention. Finance has tentatively approved the spend but needs contract start/end dates and invoice cadence.

Request / Requirements:
1) Procurement: execute 12-month enterprise contract for 50 seats with seat tiering (permanent vs ephemeral). Include automatic deprovisioning for ephemeral seats after configurable expiry (default 30 days).
2) Identity: enable SCIM provisioning from Redwood Okta instance to AuthLatch; map group attributes and role claims per mapping doc.
3) Security: validate BYOK/KMS option and that audit logs can be pushed to our S3 bucket in us-east-1 with MFA-protected access.
4) Infra: configure VPC peering/VPN or private endpoint so audit-export traffic does not traverse public internet.
5) Billing: map invoices to ENG-Platform cost center; request monthly invoicing and PO # prior to start.

Deadline / Urgency:
- Desired contract start: 2026-04-01 to coincide with contractor onboarding wave. Some teams are blocked on provisioning automation, hence P2 / Sev2.

Contact points:
- Requester: Nora Patel (Platform)
- Identity lead: Anika Shah
- Security reviewer: Michael Zhou
- Procurement owner: Carlos Mendes
